headline: Amazon plans 5,105 satellites for global cellphone network by 2028
summary: The e-commerce giant filed an FCC application to deploy a new constellation offering direct-to-device voice, messaging, and data services.
details: Amazon has submitted an FCC application to launch a new constellation of 5,105 satellites, aiming to provide direct-to-device cellphone service by 2028. This ambitious project, dubbed Amazon Leo, will offer voice, messaging, data, and emergency services.

The company plans to partner with mobile network operators, similar to Starlink's collaboration with T-Mobile, to deliver this service. Amazon also intends to leverage Globalstar's spectrum, having recently acquired the company's satellite network and its deal to provide services for Apple devices.

This new satellite network is designed to complement Amazon's existing broadband services. Beyond consumer use, the constellation will also support critical applications such as disaster response and emergency messaging, enhancing global connectivity.

The direct-to-device satellites will feature advanced processing capabilities, relaying signals from orbit to improve overall performance. This initiative significantly expands upon Amazon's initial Leo constellation, which already includes approximately 3,200 satellites, with over 375 launched to date.

headline_marked: Xbox [[services down]], preventing play of digital and disc-based games
headline: Xbox services down, preventing play of digital and disc-based games
summary: Microsoft's gaming console is experiencing widespread issues, impacting account sign-ins, the storefront, and even physical game access.
details: Xbox services are currently experiencing a significant outage, affecting users across Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One, and Xbox 360 consoles. The issues began Sunday evening and have impacted account sign-ins, the digital storefront, and various apps.

Players are reporting problems with logging into their profiles, and even those who are signed in may find themselves disconnected. Features that require sign-in, which includes most games, apps, and social activities, are currently unavailable.

Notably, the outage is preventing users from playing both digital and disc-based games. Xbox's status page acknowledges that players "may have problems" with game access, highlighting the severity of the disruption.

Microsoft's engineers are actively working to resolve the problem, with the company stating on X that they are "actively working to mitigate the issue." The Xbox status page indicates that the issue has been identified and a resolution is pending.
This outage follows a period of significant changes for Xbox, including recent layoffs affecting 1,600 workers and further planned job cuts by mid-2027.
